To add a paid stamp in QuickBooks, follow these steps:

1. Open the invoice template you want to use.
2. Right-click on the template and select "Edit Template."
3. Scroll down to the "Company & Transaction Information" section.
4. Check the box next to "Print Status Stamp."
5. Click "OK" to save the changes.

This will activate the paid stamp on the invoice, and it will be printed when the invoice is marked as paid. If you want to customize the paid stamp to include the date the invoice was paid, you can do so by going to "Additional Customization" and selecting the "Paid" stamp.
